# Uni-Mol resources

Before planning inference, obtain explicit local paths for:

- a user-approved runtime and its version;
- model weights with source, license, checksum, and task metadata;
- molecular input data with provenance, schema, identifiers, and units;
- an output directory that will not overwrite unreviewed results;
- optional GPU capacity and a stated compute budget.

If any required resource is missing or its provenance is unclear, stop and ask
the user to provide or approve it. Do not retrieve resources or contact services.
